message.content: As a doctor, I observe no visible swelling or signs of respiratory infection. Your reported stiffness and soreness might stem from muscle tension due to stress or poor posture. Perhaps you slept awkwardly, causing strain on the cervical spine. Dehydration can also irritate throat tissues without visible inflammation. Allergies might cause mild internal irritation, though external symptoms are absent. Consider recent dietary changes or environmental exposures. If pain persists, check for referred discomfort from dental issues or esophageal irritation. Maintaining hydration, gentle neck stretches, and monitoring symptoms closely will help identify triggers. Let’s track any progression before considering further diagnostics or specialist referrals.
